|game_text='''0 side — Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi'''

Deploy [[Coruscant (V) (Virtual Block 7){{!}}Coruscant]] system, [[Coruscant: Imperial City{{!}}Imperial City]], and [[A Sith's Plans]]. May deploy [[If The Trace Was Correct (V){{!}}If The Trace Was Correct]]. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] Dark Jedi. Whenever a character hit by [[Galen's Lightsaber]] or [[Vader's Lightsaber]] leaves table, opponent loses 2 Force. While this side up, may take [[Rogue Shadow]] into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Galen's immunity to attrition is +2 for each Jedi present. Flip this card if Galen or Vader at a battleground site and opponent does not have a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site.

'''7 side — Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe'''

While this side up, opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled and your Force drains at battlegrounds may not be canceled. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take any one card without ability into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If targeting a vehicle or starship with [[Lightsaber Parry]], [[Tarkin's Orders (V){{!}}Tarkin's Orders]], or [[There Is No Conflict]], that destiny draw is +2. Flip this card if opponent has a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site.
